qualification.details: Lab Technician: Intermediate (10+2) and Diploma or certified course in Medical Laboratory Technology (D/MLT) equivalent and registered with Respective Council Telangana State. One year of experience in NTEP or sputum smear microscope. Candidates with Higher qualification (for example Graduates) Shall be preferred. Senior Tuberculosis Laboratory Supervisor (STLS): Graduate or Diploma in Medical Laboratory technology or equivalent from a Government Recognized institution and registered with Respective Council Telangana State. Permanent two wheeler driving license & should be able to drive two wheeler. Certificate course in computer operations (minimum two months). Minimum of 1 year of experience in NTEP.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Hanumakonda Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://hanumakonda.telangana.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMHO Hanumakonda recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DMHO Hanumakonda Lab Technician and STLS posts is 29 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by DMHO Hanumakonda?
faq.answer: DMHO Hanumakonda has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the positions of Lab Technician and Senior Tuberculosis Laboratory Supervisor (STLS) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 44 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit. Candidates will be evaluated based on marks obtained in their qualifying examination (90 marks) and marks for age (10 marks).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-, while for SC/ST candidates, it is Rs. 250/-. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Lab Technician?
faq.answer: For the Lab Technician post, candidates need to have completed Intermediate (10+2) and possess a Diploma or certified course in Medical Laboratory Technology (D/MLT) equivalent, along with registration with the Telangana State Council.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for STLS?
faq.answer: For the Senior Tuberculosis Laboratory Supervisor (STLS) post, candidates should be Graduates or hold a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent from a recognized institution, along with other specified requirements like driving license and computer course.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the DMHO Hanumakonda recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 22,100/- to Rs. 27,300/- per month, depending on the specific post applied for. Lab Technicians can expect Rs. 27,300/- and STLS Rs. 22,100/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DMHO Hanumakonda, which is https://hanumakonda.telangana.gov.in. Direct links are also provided in the Important Links section of this article.
